briefs.headline: Using Threads
briefs.body: Threads is your journal of the rules you uncover through play, and it opens with the shown key - M by default. The Lessons tab carries survival instruction from your first minute, long before any discovery.
briefs.action: Press your Threads key, then select Lessons.

briefs.headline: Checking Survival Meters
briefs.body: Your survival meters fade when they are stable and surface when they need you. Hold Sneak to bring all of them back and see where you stand.
briefs.action: Hold Sneak and read your meters.

briefs.headline: Drinking Safe Water
briefs.body: Water at purity 3 is safe to drink. Collect rain, melt snow by a campfire, and carry it in bottles - bottles fit Curios slots, so keep some on hand.
briefs.action: Prepare safe drinking water before you travel.

briefs.headline: Balancing Nutrition
briefs.body: Hunger and nutrition are separate. Six food groups unlock abilities at 20, 40, 60, and 80%. Meat, eggs, fruit, and dairy cover the early ground; imported seeds open grain and garden foods.
briefs.action: Open nutrition and look at your lowest group.

briefs.headline: Increasing Maximum Health
briefs.body: Every new food you eat permanently raises your maximum health. Try things you have not eaten before, not just the ones that refill you.
briefs.action: Try a food you have never eaten.

briefs.headline: Sugar and Alcohol
briefs.body: Sweetness multiplies your unlocked food benefits and sharply raises hunger and nutrition drain. Alcohol dulls movement and work the longer it lasts; too much ends in a blackout.
briefs.action: Check your nutrition before sweets or a drink.

briefs.headline: Managing Body Temperature
briefs.body: Your body temperature is not the air temperature. Clothing, shelter, biome, season, and the temperature of your food all move it. Prepare before you travel into hot or cold ground.
briefs.action: Bring clothing suited to where you are going.

briefs.headline: Movement Controls
briefs.body: Advanced movement runs on stamina. Fast run is Shift, vault is Mouse 5, dodge is R - directional double-tap dodging is off. Each has its own key and its own cost.
briefs.action: Practice the movements on safe ground.

briefs.headline: Sleeping Safely
briefs.body: Sleep moves the hours along; the world does not pause for it. Weather, temperature, ecology, and active threats all continue. Check the area before you use a bed.
briefs.action: Secure the area before you sleep.

briefs.headline: Death’s Door Is Survivable
briefs.body: The hit that drops your positive HP to zero leaves you at Death's Door with an injury. You can still move and act. Healing is briefly locked and further hits can kill, so reach safety first; when healing returns, restore HP to regain its buffer.
briefs.action: Find safety, then open Body from your inventory.

briefs.headline: Healing and Treatment Are Separate
briefs.body: Restoring HP does not remove injuries. Open Body, match medicine to the injury type, and each finished treatment removes one. Repeated hits add trauma that amplifies movement, arm, and torso penalties; trauma expires, injuries do not.
briefs.action: Open Body and select an injury to treat.

briefs.headline: Spending Life Points
briefs.body: Life stat choices are permanent for this life and reset on death. Constitution, for example, reduces hunger, thirst, and stamina use. Read each stat before you spend.
briefs.action: Review the effects before applying your points.

briefs.headline: Seasonal Farming
briefs.body: Seasons decide which crops and trees do well. Check the seasonal feedback before you plant, and store surplus for the leaner seasons.
briefs.action: Plant crops suited to the current season.

briefs.headline: Preparing for Storms
briefs.body: Storms travel the world and batter exposed ground. Watch the weather turn, and keep a route to shelter you could walk in a hurry.
briefs.action: Reach shelter before a severe storm arrives.

briefs.headline: Managing Pollution
briefs.body: Pollution spreads and harms living things, including you. Detect it, wear protection, route emissions through chimneys and filters, and clean up what has already settled.

briefs.headline: Supporting Buildings
briefs.body: Buildings stand on support - foundations, walls, columns. Spans and platforms need it added as they grow, not after.
briefs.action: Add supports before you extend a platform.

briefs.headline: Placing Item Displays
briefs.body: Look at a block face and press the shown key to set a held item out as a display. Sneak-press with empty hands to rotate the whole display; sneak-use an item to rotate just that.
briefs.action: Place a display with the shown key.

briefs.headline: Pillager Assault Warnings
briefs.body: Pillager scouts show up far more often than full assaults. When an assault is coming you hear about it in advance - time to gather allies, fortify the approaches, and reach shelter.
briefs.action: Prepare defenses when an assault is announced.
